name: Editor timeline with the speaker in the preview
description: A dark video-editor window: a small 9:16 preview monitor at the top plays the speaker's own video with a running timecode under it; below it a timeline with track labels V2, V1, A1, A2, orange clip blocks, grey picture clips, a green audio waveform and a red playhead that a cursor grabs and drags back and forth (scrubbing) while the timecode jumps.
use_when: Lines about editing footage yourself or sitting in an editing app: 'then you scrub through the timeline', 'hours in the editor', 'cutting it all together', 'finding the good take'.

scrub.help: true: the cursor drags the playhead back and forth; false: it just plays forward
